summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a capital increase of 28,144 Class A common shares (par value $0.01 each) due to the exercise of Restricted Share Units under its incentive program. The new shares were subscribed in cash at prices of DKK 127.30, DKK 139.90, and DKK 195.50 per share across three tranches. This is a routine equity issuance related to employee compensation, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or strategic event is involved. The shares will be admitted to trading on Nasdaq Copenhagen. There is no risk-arb angle as this is a standard capital increase for incentive plan settlement.
